description: Logical uninstall — marks every ownership row for the namespace inactive while leaving tables and data on disk. Reversible via install_plugin_schema (which reactivates and applies any new diff). To actually drop the data, call purge_plugin_schema after.
embedding_description: Mark a plugin's installed schema inactive without dropping tables or losing data. Logical uninstall: marks every ownership row for the namespace inactive while tables + data stay on disk. Reversible via install_plugin_schema (reactivates + applies any new diff). To actually drop data, call purge_plugin_schema after. Returns status (uninstalled / not_installed).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Lifecycle outcome with status (uninstalled | not_installed), namespace, tables marked inactive, and data_preserved=true.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Marks the plugin-schema ownership rows inactive for the namespace. Tables and data on disk are not touched — uninstall is intentionally reversible.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Most failures are connectivity or transactional issues at the Postgres layer; the lifecycle itself does not raise on a not-yet-installed namespace (returns status='not_installed').
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For Postgres connectivity errors: confirm postgres_state_management_plugin is healthy. The transaction rolls back atomically on failure.
